examples.step_description: Automatically archive courses and learner transcripts, stay compliant, and retrieve anything in seconds.
examples.prereq_step1: Create your free account at www.chronifyai.com (opens in a new tab).
examples.prereq_step2: Go to the Integrations page in your ChronifyAI dashboard.
examples.prereq_step3: Select Moodle and copy your API Base URL, Client ID, and Client Secret.
examples.prereq_step4: Come back here and click Continue Setup below to enter those credentials.
